items.t: What are the main issues driving Spain's national election ?
items.s: Spain will elect a new government on Sunday in a snap election that could unseat Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. The progressive leader has governed Spain for 8 years, presiding over several crises, years of economic expansion and immigration-led population growth. No issue, however, has affected Spaniards during this time as much as unaffordable housing.

items.t: World Health Organization sounds alarm as measles fight stalls
items.s: Global measles deaths hit a historic low in 2025, the World Health Organization said on Friday, although millions of children ⁠still missed vaccinations and outbreaks persisted in dozens of countries.
